Principle 04 of 8

Fairness

Treat people equally, do not discriminate, and keep services accessible.

Protects

Customers, applicants, workers

Why it matters

Access to credit, housing, work, and services should not depend on who someone is or where they live.

Covers

Automated and human decisions about people (6.1–6.3, 6.5), and access, equity, and discrimination (Category 9).

1.5 Loyalty Penalty & Incumbency Pricing · 5 practices

Fairness+ Honesty
§PracticeDescriptionSeen in
1.5.1Price CreepGradual, repeated price increases above inflation, exploiting customer inertia and switching costs.SaaS, streaming, insurance, mobile carriers, cleaning services
1.5.2Loyalty PenaltyCharging long-term customers more than new customers for identical coverage or service.Insurance, mobile carriers, energy utilities
1.5.3Teaser-Rate TrapOffering low introductory pricing that escalates dramatically after the first renewal cycle.Insurance, mobile carriers, cosmetics (subscription), gym memberships
1.5.4Auto-Renewal Price HikeRenewing a subscription at a higher price than the prior term without explicit consent or prominent advance notice.Cloud/SaaS, streaming, cybersecurity, fitness, dating, telecom
1.5.5Mile / Point DevaluationUnilaterally reducing the value, redemption availability, or expiration window of accumulated loyalty points or miles.Airlines, hotels, retail loyalty programs, credit-card rewards

Fairness+ Care
§PracticeDescriptionSeen in

1.7.5Negative-Equity RollingRolling negative equity from a previous loan into a new loan without clearly disclosing the increased total obligation.Automotive

1.7.7Refund-Advance APR ConcealmentMarketing refund anticipation loans as "instant refunds" while obscuring effective interest rates that often exceed 100% APR.Tax preparation
1.7.8Pre-Need Investment MisrepresentationMarketing pre-paid funeral or cemetery products as appreciating financial investments rather than prepaid services.Funeral & death care
1.7.9Payment-Plan Predatory TermsOffering high-interest installment plans for essential expenditures without disclosing total interest paid.Veterinary, dental, healthcare, mental health

Fairness
§PracticeDescriptionSeen in

6.1.5Therapist-Matching BiasAlgorithmic matching that systematically steers marginalized patients to less experienced or lower-rated providers.Mental health
6.1.6Recommendation Pop-BiasRecommendation systems that reinforce already-dominant artists, products, or content, suppressing emerging or underrepresented voices.Music, podcasting, e-commerce
6.1.7Facial-Recognition BiasDeploying facial recognition with documented demographic error disparities, leading to wrongful identification.Surveillance technology, law enforcement
